fact: The June 2026 PNGF bulletin says SIFCOM is designed to interoperate with DGID's SGF, that full SIFCOM-SGF interoperability is a major issue for coming months, and that SIFCOM could be connected to SENTRESOR for online payment.
title: Dynamiques actuelles du foncier au Sénégal : innovations et réformes
publisher: Plateforme Nationale sur la Gouvernance Foncière (PNGF)
